Mary, mother of Jesus: 1 Januwale, Maria Woyera Amayi wa Mulungu

Namwali Maria Woyera, Amayi wa Mulungu ndi Amayi a Mpingo, wosankhidwa kuyambira muyaya kubereka Mpulumutsi. Anatengedwa m'mimba wopanda uchimo ndipo ndi namwali nthawi zonse; anakwezedwa kumwamba ndi thupi ndi moyo.
Our Lady of Guadalupe: Mu 1531 Namwali Wodala anaonekera kwa Woyera Juan Diego pa phiri la Tepeyac pafupi ndi mzinda wa Mexico, nasiya chithunzi chake pa chofunda chake. Iye ndi Woyang'anira wa Amerika.
Our Lady of Fátima: Mu 1917 Namwali Wodala anaonekera kwa ana atatu oweta ziweto ku Fatima, Portugal, naitana dziko lapansi ku pemphero, kulapa, Rozari ya tsiku ndi tsiku ndi kudzipereka ku Mtima wake Wosalakwa.
Our Lady of Lourdes: Mu 1858 Namwali Wodala anaonekera kwa Woyera Bernadette nthawi khumi ndi zisanu ndi zitatu ku Lourdes, France, nati: "Ine ndine Wotengedwa M'mimba Wopanda Uchimo." Kasupe wake wakhala malo a machiritso ndi maulendo opatulika kuyambira pamenepo.
Our Lady of Aparecida: Mu 1717 asodzi anatulutsa m'mtsinje wa Paraíba chifanizo chaching'ono cha Wotengedwa Wopanda Uchimo, ndipo makoka awo opanda kanthu anadzaza ndi nsomba. Maria wa Aparecida ndi Mfumukazi ndi Woyang'anira wa Brazil.
Our Mother of Perpetual Help: Chithunzi choyera chakale chosonyeza Mwana Yesu akuthawira kwa Amayi ake ataona zida za Mazunzo ake. Wodala Pius IX anachipereka kwa Aredemptorist mu 1866 kuti achidziwitse padziko lonse.
Our Lady of the Pillar: Mwambo umati Namwali Wodala anabwera kwa Woyera Yakobo Mtumwi ku Zaragoza kudzalimbikitsa ulaliki wake ku Spain, nasiya mzati ngati chizindikiro. Iye ndi Woyang'anira wa Spain ndi anthu olankhula Chisipanishi.
Our Lady of Mount Carmel: Mayi Wathu wa Phiri la Karmeli
Maria monga Amayi ndi Woyang'anira wa Gulu la Akarmeli. Anapatsa Woyera Simon Stock Skapulari ya bulauni ngati chizindikiro cha chitetezo chake kwa onse amene amaivala ndi chikhulupiriro.
Our Lady of the Rosary: Phwando ili limakumbukira chigonjetso cha ku Lepanto mu 1571, chopezedwa pamene okhulupirira ankapemphera Rozari. Limatiitana kusinkhasinkha zinsinsi za Khristu pamodzi ndi Amayi ake.
Our Lady of Sorrows: Limalemekeza kugawana kwa Mayi Wodala m'Mazunzo a Mwana wake kudzera m'zisoni zake zisanu ndi ziwiri, kuyambira ulosi wa Simeoni kufikira kuikidwa m'manda kwa Yesu. Anaima mokhulupirika pansi pa Mtanda.
Immaculate Conception: Mwa chisomo chapadera cha Mulungu, Namwali Maria Woyera anasungidwa wopanda uchimo woyambirira kuyambira mphindi yoyamba ya kutengedwa kwake m'mimba. Ndi phwando la woyang'anira wa Amerika.
Assumption of Mary: Pamapeto pa moyo wake wa padziko lapansi, Namwali Maria Woyera anakwezedwa ndi thupi ndi moyo ku ulemerero wa kumwamba, monga Papa Pius XII analengeza mwalamulo mu 1950.
Sacred Heart: Lachisanu lotsatira Lamlungu lachiwiri pambuyo pa Pentekoste
Kudzipereka ku Mtima Woyera wa Yesu kumalemekeza chikondi chake choyaka kwa anthu. Ambuye anaululira Woyera Margaret Mary Alacoque malonjezo ake m'zaka za m'ma 1670.
Holy Family: Yesu, Maria ndi Yosefe m'nyumba yawo ku Nazarete, chitsanzo cha banja lililonse lachikhristu m'chikhulupiriro, m'chikondi ndi m'kumvera Mulungu.
Trinity: Chinsinsi chachikulu cha chikhulupiriro chathu: Mulungu mmodzi mu Anthu atatu aumulungu, Atate, Mwana ndi Mzimu Woyera.
Holy Spirit in Christianity: Munthu wachitatu wa Utatu Woyera, Ambuye ndi Wopatsa moyo, amene anatsikira pa Atumwi pa Pentekoste ndipo amayeretsa Mpingo.
Christ the King: Lamlungu lomaliza la chaka cha mapemphero
Papa Pius XI anakhazikitsa phwando lalikulu ili mu 1925 kulengeza ufumu wa Yesu Khristu pa mtima uliwonse, banja ndi mtundu.
Divine Mercy: Kudzipereka ku chikondi chachifundo cha Mulungu choululidwa kwa Woyera Faustina Kowalska, chofotokozedwa m'pemphero "Yesu, ndikudalira Inu." Woyera Yohane Paulo II anakhazikitsa Lamlungu la Chifundo cha Mulungu mu 2000.
Santo Niño de Cebú: Chifanizo cha Mwana Yesu Woyera choperekedwa pa ubatizo wa mfumukazi ya Cebu mu 1521, chifanizo chachikhristu chakale kwambiri ku Philippines.
Juan Diego: Woyera Juan Diego Cuauhtlatoatzin, mbadwa yodzichepetsa yotembenuka mtima, amene Mayi Wathu wa Guadalupe anamuonekera mu 1531. Woyera Yohane Paulo II anamuyika kukhala woyera mu 2002.
Kateri Tekakwitha: "Duwa la Lilia la Amohawk" (1656–1680), namwali wotembenuka mtima, woyera mtima ndi wopemphera kwambiri, woyera woyamba wa mbadwa ku North America.
Martin de Porres: M'bale wa Adominiko ku Lima, Peru (1579–1639), wodziwika chifukwa cha chisamaliro chake chodzichepetsa kwa odwala ndi osauka a mitundu yonse. Woyang'anira wa chilungamo pakati pa anthu.
Francis Xavier: Mmodzi mwa Ayezuiti oyamba, anabweretsa Uthenga Wabwino ku India, kumwera chakum'mawa ndi kum'mawa kwa Asia ndi ku Japan, nabatiza zikwi zambiri. Woyang'anira wa mamishoni.
Francis de Sales: Bishopu wa Geneva ndi Mphunzitsi wa Mpingo (1567–1622), amene anaphunzitsa kuti munthu aliyense akuitanidwa ku chiyero. Woyang'anira wa olemba ndi atolankhani.
Saint Joseph: Mwamuna wa Namwali Maria Woyera ndi bambo wolera wa Yesu, munthu wolungama amene anateteza Banja Loyera. Woyang'anira wa Mpingo wonse, abambo, ogwira ntchito ndi imfa yabwino.
Saint Patrick: Bishopu ndi Mtumwi wa Ireland m'zaka za m'ma 400. Anatengedwa ku Ireland ngati kapolo ali mnyamata, nabwerera ngati mmishonale nabweretsa chilumbachi ku chikhulupiriro.
Anthony of Padua: Wansembe wa Afransisikani ndi Mphunzitsi wa Mpingo (1195–1231), mlaliki wamphamvu ndi wochita zozizwitsa. Woyang'anira wa osauka ndi zinthu zotayika.
Francis of Assisi: Woyambitsa Afransisikani (1181–1226), amene analandira umphawi kutsatira Khristu nalandira zilonda za Ambuye. Woyang'anira wa Italy ndi nyama.
John the Baptist: Wotsogolera wa Ambuye, amene analalikira kulapa, anabatiza Yesu mu Yordano ndipo anapereka moyo wake ngati wofera chikhulupiriro chifukwa cha choonadi.
Michael (archangel): Kalonga wa gulu lankhondo la kumwamba, amene amateteza anthu a Mulungu ku misampha ya Satana. Woyang'anira wa asilikali, apolisi ndi odwala.
Raphael (archangel): Mngelo wamkulu amene anatsogolera Tobiya nachiritsa Tobiti; dzina lake limatanthauza "Mulungu amachiritsa." Woyang'anira wa apaulendo ndi machiritso.
Gabriel: Mngelo wamkulu amene analengeza kwa Namwali Maria kuti adzakhala Amayi wa Mwana wa Mulungu. Woyang'anira wa amithenga.
Saint Peter: Mtsogoleri wa Atumwi ndi Papa woyamba, amene Khristu anampatsa makiyi a Ufumu. Anaphedwa ngati wofera chikhulupiriro ku Roma ndipo wagona pansi pa Tchalitchi Chachikulu cha Woyera Petro.
Paul the Apostle: Mtumwi wa Amitundu, amene anatembenuka mtima panjira ya ku Damasiko. Maulendo ake ndi makalata ake anafikitsa Uthenga Wabwino m'dziko lonse la Aroma, ndipo anaphedwa ngati wofera chikhulupiriro ku Roma.
Saint Anne: Amayi a Namwali Maria Woyera ndi agogo a Yesu, olemekezedwa pamodzi ndi Woyera Yowakimu. Woyang'anira wa amayi ndi agogo.
Thérèse of Lisieux: Sisitere wa Akarmeli ndi Mphunzitsi wa Mpingo (1873–1897), Duwa Laling'ono, amene anaphunzitsa "njira yaing'ono" ya kudalira ndi chikondi. Woyang'anira wa mamishoni.
Jude the Apostle: Mtumwi ndi m'bale wa Ambuye, amene analemba Kalata ya Yuda. Woyang'anira wa zinthu zopanda chiyembekezo.
Vincent de Paul: Wansembe wa ku France (1581–1660) amene anayambitsa Gulu la Mamishoni ndi Ana Aakazi a Chikondi. Woyang'anira wa ntchito zonse zachifundo.
Thomas Aquinas: Wansembe wa Adominiko ndi Mphunzitsi wa Mpingo (1225–1274), amene analemba Summa Theologiae. Woyang'anira wa masukulu a Katolika ndi ophunzira.
Rita of Cascia: Mkazi, mayi, mkazi wamasiye ndi sisitere wa Aogustini (1381–1457) amene anapirira mazunzo ndi kuleza mtima kwakukulu. Woyang'anira wa zinthu zosatheka.
Augustine of Hippo: Bishopu ndi Mphunzitsi wa Mpingo (354–430), amene anatembenuka mtima chifukwa cha mapemphero a amayi ake, Woyera Monika. Analemba Kuvomereza.
Saint Monica: Amayi a Woyera Augustine, amene analandira kutembenuka mtima kwa mwana wake patatha zaka zambiri za pemphero lokhulupirika. Woyang'anira wa amayi ndi akazi okwatiwa.
Saint Sebastian: Msilikali wa Chiroma amene anaphedwa chifukwa cha chikhulupiriro m'nthawi ya Diocletian cha m'ma 288. Woyang'anira wa asilikali ndi ochita masewera.
Saint Lawrence: Dikoni wa Roma amene anaphedwa ngati wofera chikhulupiriro mu 258, amene anaonetsa osauka ngati chuma chenicheni cha Mpingo. Woyang'anira wa madikoni ndi osauka.
Saint Stephen: Mmodzi mwa madikoni asanu ndi awiri oyamba ndi wofera chikhulupiriro woyamba wa Mpingo, amene anafa akupempherera omwe ankamuponya miyala.
Saint Nicholas: Bishopu wa Myra m'zaka za m'ma 300, wokondedwa chifukwa cha chifundo chake ndi mphatso zake zachinsinsi. Woyang'anira wa ana ndi oyendetsa sitima zapamadzi.
Saint George: Msilikali ndi wofera chikhulupiriro woyambirira wa m'ma 300, chitsanzo cha kulimba mtima m'chikhulupiriro. Woyang'anira wa asilikali ndi ma sikauti.
James the Great: Mtumwi ndi m'bale wa Woyera Yohane, woyamba mwa Khumi ndi Awiri kuphedwa ngati wofera chikhulupiriro. Malo ake opatulika ku Santiago de Compostela amakoka oyendera pa Camino. Woyang'anira wa Spain.
Andrew the Apostle: M'bale wa Woyera Petro ndi Mtumwi woyamba kuitanidwa, amene anabweretsa Petro kwa Yesu. Anaphedwa pa mtanda ku Patras. Woyang'anira wa Scotland.
Martin of Tours: Msilikali wa Chiroma amene anagawana chofunda chake ndi wopemphapempha, kenako anakhala Bishopu wa Tours (anamwalira 397). Woyang'anira wa asilikali.
Benedict of Nursia: Bambo wa moyo wa amonke Kumadzulo (cha m'ma 480–547), amene Lamulo lake la pemphero ndi ntchito latsogolera amonke kwa zaka mazana ambiri. Woyang'anira wa Ulaya.
Saint Dominic: Woyambitsa Gulu la Alaliki (1170–1221), wodzipereka kulalikira choonadi ndi ku Rozari.
Ignatius of Loyola: Msilikali amene anakhala woyera (1491–1556), amene anayambitsa Gulu la Yesu nalemba Zochita Zauzimu, zonse "chifukwa cha ulemerero waukulu wa Mulungu."
Charles Borromeo: Arkibishopu wa Milan (1538–1584) amene anakonzanso Mpingo pambuyo pa Bungwe la Trent nasamalira odwala pa mliri.
Elizabeth Ann Seton: Mkazi, mayi, mkazi wamasiye ndi wotembenuka mtima (1774–1821), amene anayambitsa Asisitere a Chikondi ndi masukulu a Katolika ku America. Woyera woyamba wobadwira ku United States.
Isidore the Laborer: Wogwira ntchito m'munda ku Madrid (anamwalira 1130), wokhulupirika ku Misa ya tsiku ndi tsiku ndi wowolowa manja kwa osauka. Woyang'anira wa alimi.
Saint Lucy: Namwali ndi wofera chikhulupiriro wa ku Syracuse (anamwalira 304), amene dzina lake limatanthauza "kuwala." Woyang'anira wa akhungu.
Saint Cecilia: Namwali ndi wofera chikhulupiriro wa ku Roma amene ankaimbira Mulungu mumtima mwake. Woyang'anira wa oimba ndi nyimbo zopatulika.
Clare of Assisi: Wotsatira wa Woyera Francis (1194–1253) ndi woyambitsa Aklara Osauka, wodzipereka ku umphawi ndi ku Sakramenti Lodala.
Pope John Paul II: Papa kuyambira 1978 mpaka 2005, wobadwa Karol Wojtyła ku Poland, mlendo wosatopa amene anauza dziko lapansi "musaope." Anayikidwa kukhala woyera mu 2014.
Pope Pius X: Papa kuyambira 1903 mpaka 1914 amene analimbikitsa kulandira Mgonero kawirikawiri naulola kwa ana aang'ono, "kukonzanso zinthu zonse mwa Khristu."
Luke the Evangelist: Woyera Luka Mlembi wa Uthenga Wabwino
Dokotala ndi mnzake wa Woyera Paulo, amene analemba Uthenga Wabwino wa Luka ndi Machitidwe a Atumwi. Woyang'anira wa madokotala ndi ojambula.
Mark the Evangelist: Woyera Marko Mlembi wa Uthenga Wabwino
Mnzake wa Woyera Petro ndi mlembi wa Uthenga Wabwino wa Marko. Woyang'anira wa Venice.
Matthew the Apostle: Wokhometsa msonkho amene Yesu anamuitana kukhala Mtumwi, amene analemba Uthenga Wabwino woyamba.
Bartholomew the Apostle: Mmodzi mwa Khumi ndi Awiri, amene Ambuye anamutcha "Mwisraeli weniweni amene mwa iye mulibe chinyengo," analalikira Uthenga Wabwino nafa ngati wofera chikhulupiriro.
Helena, mother of Constantine I: Mfumukazi ndi amayi a Constantine Wamkulu, amene anapeza Mtanda weniweni paulendo wake wopatulika ku Yerusalemu.
Brigid of Kildare: Mkulu wa asisitere ku Kildare (anamwalira cha m'ma 525), wokondedwa chifukwa cha chifundo chake ndi kulandira alendo. Woyang'anira wa Ireland.
Louis IX of France: Mfumu ya France (1214–1270), wolamulira wolungama wodzipereka ku pemphero ndi kwa osauka.
